intro x
let S := LieSubalgebra.engel K x
have hS : LieSubalgebra K S := by apply LieSubalgebra.of_submodule; apply Module.submodule_of_finite_rank
let C := LinearMap.charpoly (LieAlgebra.ad K L x)
let d := C.natTrailingDegree
let f := C.coeff d
have hf : f ≠ 0 := by rw [C.natTrailingDegree]; exact Ne.def.mp (Nat.succ_ne_zero d)
let m := Module.finrank K S
have hm : m = d := by
  have h1 : Module.finrank K S = Module.finrank K (LinearMap.ker (LieAlgebra.ad K L x) ^ (d + 1)) :=
    by apply Module.finrank_eq_ker_ad_pow; exact hf
  have h2 : Module.finrank K (LinearMap.ker (LieAlgebra.ad K L x) ^ (d + 1)) = d :=
    by apply Module.finrank_ker_ad_pow; exact hf
  exact Eq.trans h1 h2
exact hm
